newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks climb, blue chips sought actively.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks climb, blue chips sought actively.

text.p: Toyota stocks rose in early Thursday afternoon trade, as pension funds sought blue-chip issues, brokers said.
They said that market sentiment was brightening due to the trickle of new funds into the stock market.
As of 0425 GMT, the Nikkei 225 was 146.52 points or 0.78 percent higher at 18,881.99. Its June futures were 110 points higher at 18,880.
